provenance.rebuilt: CCCBDB's Cartesian table disagrees with its own listed parameters (rCO (2, 3): listed 1.162, Cartesians give 1.1600; rCH (1, 4): listed 1.083, Cartesians give 1.0790; aHCH (4, 1, 5): listed 122.56, Cartesians give 122.3044; aHCC (2, 1, 4): listed 118.72, Cartesians give 118.8478), so the Cartesians were rebuilt from the listed parameters by a least-squares fit.
